summary: Implement Proxy [[OwnPropertyKeys]] via ownKeys trap, validating key types, duplicates, and target-key invariants.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.trap_result: CreateListFromArrayLike; every element must be String or Symbol and no duplicates
semantics.ordering: accepted trap list order is observable
semantics.invariants: all non-configurable target keys must be present; if target non-extensible, result must contain exactly all target own keys

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: trap controls observable order when legal
